title: Sable Hub | Auto Play, Auto Attack, Auto Command, ESP
features:
Fighter
- 1 Click Auto Play (Premium): joins, fights, commands your army and takes objectives for you
- Auto Attack with target priority: Nearest, Players first or Troops first
- Face Target
- Chase Enemies with adjustable range
- Auto Heal at the health % you pick
- Auto Block when an enemy commander swings at you

Army
- Auto Command: attacks when enemies are close, follows you otherwise
- Auto Rush with a range limit so charges are never wasted
- Instant Attack and Follow orders

Match
- Auto Join Match: smaller team, Attackers or Defenders
- Auto March On Objectives
- Live session stats: swings, rushes, matches, gems, tickets

Rewards
- Auto Claim Daily Reward
- Auto Claim Quests
- Claim Everything Now

Visuals
- Enemy Commander ESP with class, health and distance
- Army ESP with troop type and soldiers left
- Objective ESP
- Full Bright

Safety
- Shows whether the game's anti cheat is on
- Anti AFK
